hits.about: Zada Tower is a 26-story tower located in Dubai's Business Bay business district. The building is planned exclusively for one-bedroom apartments. The complex will contain a total of 699 units. This collection of apartments from renowned developer Damac Properties features premium residences with their own open-air movie theater, where family evenings can be enjoyed. The interior of the residences is kept in a minimalist style with the use of light colors and the addition of contrasting dark elements in the form of furniture or wall panels. The apartments are characterized by stunning views of the cityscape and first-class amenities. Every detail has been thought out to ensure the highest level of comfort for residents.Residents have access to amenities such as a temperature-controlled swimming pool, state-of-the-art gym, steam rooms and saunas, as well as 24-hour security and concierge services.The complex is built close to Downtown Dubai. Residents can easily get to any location by public transportation. One of the most popular ways of transportation is the subway. The nearest station to the residential complex is in Business Bay, a 15-minute walk away. There are several bus stops near the complex.Metro station is just a 12-minute walk away, and the proximity to Sheikh Zayed Road Expressway provides easy access to any part of the city. Surrounding Zada Tower are the entertainment and social facilities required for the modern man.
hits.title: Zada Tower
